headlines.description: — Jalen Duren had 20 points, Duncan Robinson scored 19 and the Detroit Pistons beat Charlotte 118-100 on Friday night, locking the Hornets into the play-in tournament.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Duren scores 20 points and the Detroit Pistons beat the Charlotte Hornets 118-100

headlines.description: — The Washington Wizards clinched the worst record in the NBA on Friday night with a 140-117 loss to the Miami Heat.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wizards clinch NBA's worst record with 140-117 loss to Heat
